name: textarea
title: Textarea
purpose: Collect multi-line text with a visible label, validation feedback, and deliberate editing geometry.

composition.sizing: rows supplies the native initial height. autoExpand grows to content and, when maxHeight is reached, scrolls internally. resizable selects none, vertical, or both-axis manual resizing.

accessibility: Always provide a unique id and visible label.
Invalid feedback exposes aria-invalid and role alert.
Loading disables editing and exposes aria-busy.
Auto expansion does not move focus or replace native textarea semantics.
commonMistakes: Using a textarea for short values that fit Input.
Enabling autoExpand without a maxHeight for unbounded user-generated content.
Using both-axis resizing in constrained layouts.
Using placeholder text as the only label.
